summary.text: This CV is a working example, technical product demonstration and open application.
I combine technology and innovation management with strategy and finance.
Evidence: GenAI at CENVION | decision analysis for Swisscom and Airbus.
I also bring M&A, banking and consulting experience. If that fits, let's talk.
To adapt it: target profile | differentiation | two evidenced results | value offered.

lines.text: Some cover letters begin with enthusiasm for one vacancy. This one begins more honestly:
I am looking for a role connecting innovation management and technology with strategy and finance.
Along the way, ccvl demonstrates how I structure applications like this one.
At CENVION, I introduced Claude and RAG-based search into investment and reporting workflows.
At Airbus, I turned 20+ years of safety-critical data into risk and cost signals; at Swisscom,
I modelled cloud economics and infrastructure decisions – technology used to improve real decisions.
The commercial side belongs in the same picture: project-finance and M&A models, eight-figure investments,
CHF 10m+ supplier negotiations and end-to-end project P&L in my own consulting work.
I can build a prototype and explain the strategic and commercial case for building it.
That does not produce a linear specialist profile – fortunately: I understand emerging technology hands-on,
frame its strategic relevance and carry it into delivery with a sound business case.
The more interesting problems tend to live at exactly those intersections.
If your team needs someone who does more than put innovation on slides – someone who analyses it,
builds it and translates it commercially – we should talk. Here for the template? Fork it, add your facts,
verify every claim, and turn the same framework into a strong cover letter of your own.
